title: Hysteria
lyrics:
[00:41.02]It's bugging me, grating me
[00:46.22]And twisting me around
[00:50.59]Yeah, I'm endlessly caving in
[00:56.48]And turning inside out
[01:00.83]'Cause I want it now, I want it now
[01:07.47]Give me your heart and your soul
[01:11.17]And I'm breaking out, I'm breaking out
[01:17.70]Last chance to lose control
[01:31.98]Yeah, it's holding me, morphing me
[01:37.83]And forcing me to strive
[01:42.19]To be endlessly cold within
[01:48.09]And dreaming I'm alive
[01:52.42]'Cause I want it now, I want it now
[01:59.06]Give me your heart and your soul
[02:02.67]I'm not breaking down, I'm breaking out
[02:09.31]Last chance to lose control
[03:04.71]And I want you now, I want you now
[03:11.28]I'll feel my heart implode
[03:15.10]And I'm breaking out, escaping now
[03:21.62]Feeling my faith erode
